raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 arrived with lowercase status values ('posted'/'reversed') and '$'-prefixed amounts. The case-sensitive filter status = 'POSTED' dropped every row in the batch, and the '$' would also have broken the DECIMAL cast. Normalizing status case and stripping '$' from amount recovers the 323 posted rows. The 16 reversed rows stay excluded, as in other batches.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(amount), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED'"}}
